problem: Find $B=\overset{―}{A}$, where $A=[\begin{aligned}7-\text{i} & 6+4\text{i} \\ 7-4\text{i} & 4+9\text{i}\end{aligned}].$ What is the value of ${b}_{12}-{b}_{21}?$

examples.knowledge_point: Calculating the Complex Conjugate of a Complex Matrix
examples.problem: Find $B=\overline{A},$ where ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14045065/assets/25ce0cd375da320d1615cf49f659ec33e4646cf6bc66455198bec5fd591b3dd3.png) What is the value of $b_{11} + b_{23}?$
examples.worked_solution:
Taking the complex conjugate of each entry, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{A} & =\overset{―}{[\begin{aligned}4\text{i} & 3-\text{i} & 1+\text{i} \\ 2-2\text{i} & 2-\text{i} & 1+2\text{i} \\ \text{i} & 3\text{i} & 2\text{i}\end{aligned}]} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{4\text{i}} & \overset{―}{3-\text{i}} & \overset{―}{1+\text{i}} \\ \overset{―}{2-2\text{i}} & \overset{―}{2-\text{i}} & \overset{―}{1+2\text{i}} \\ \overset{―}{\text{i}} & \overset{―}{3\text{i}} & \overset{―}{2\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-4\text{i} & 3+\text{i} & 1-\text{i} \\ 2+2\text{i} & 2+\text{i} & 1-2\text{i} \\ -\text{i} & -3\text{i} & -2\text{i}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $b_{11} + b_{23} = (-4\textrm{i}) + (1-2\textrm{i}) = 1-6\textrm{i}.$
